words.tr: phrase. 暂停；休息时间；超时
words.ex: The coach called a time-out to talk to the players.
words.ex_cn: 教练叫了一个暂停来和球员们谈话。
words.en: A time-out is a short period in a game or activity when play is stopped, often used by coaches or players to discuss strategy or rest.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.ex: The students participated in a history quiz at school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们参加了学校举办的历史知识竞赛。
words.en: A quiz is a test or a game in which someone asks you questions to find out how much you know about a subject.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师给了我关于学习的好建议。
words.en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

words.ex: His silence suggested he was unhappy.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他并不开心。
words.en: If you suggest something, you put forward a plan or idea for someone to think about.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.tr: n. 学校作业；课堂作业；
words.ex: He finished his schoolwork before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了学校作业。
words.en: Schoolwork refers to the work that students are required to do as part of their studies at school.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The organizational structure is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 组织结构清晰而简单。
words.en: Relating to the way in which the different parts of something are arranged or organized.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.tr: adj. 奇妙的；魔术的；有魔力的；
words.ex: The magical night lit up the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 奇妙的夜晚照亮了整个村庄。
words.en: Something that is magical seems to use magic or to be full of magic.

words.ex: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家网上工作。
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.tr: adj. 引起兴趣的； v. 吸引；“appeal”的现在分词；
words.ex: The book has an appealing story.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个引人入胜的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as appealing, you mean that you like them or they make you want to have or do something.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.ex: She will divide the cake into two parts.
words.ex_cn: 她将把蛋糕分成两部分。
words.en: If you divide something, you separate it into two or more parts.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.ex: The note on the fridge is a reminder to buy milk.
words.ex_cn: 冰箱上的便条是提醒买牛奶的东西。
words.en: A reminder is something that makes you think about or remember someone or something else.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.ex: He wrote a memo to remind the team.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一封备忘录提醒团队。
words.en: A memo is a short official note that is sent by one person to another within the same company or organization.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: The loud music was a distraction while I tried to study.
words.ex_cn: 当我试图学习时，大声的音乐让我分心。
words.en: Something that makes it difficult for you to concentrate on what you are doing.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细阅读了文本。
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.ex: He stepped aside to let the bus pass.
words.ex_cn: 他走到一旁，让公交车通过。
words.en: If you move something aside, you move it to one side of you, usually because it is in the way.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The CEO made a decision to expand the company.
words.ex_cn: 首席执行官决定扩大公司。
words.en: The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) is the highest-ranking person in a company or other institution, ultimately responsible for making managerial decisions.

words.tr: adj. 教育的；有教育意义的；
words.ex: This is an educational video for children.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个为儿童制作的教育视频。
words.en: Educational means relating to education or the process of education.

words.tr:
v. 预备；准备
n. 家庭作业；预习功课
adj. 准备的
words.ex: He is preparing for the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为考试做准备。
words.en: Preparation or preliminary work, especially in education or before an event.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: He is a big fan of soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他是足球的忠实粉丝。
words.en: A fan is a device that creates a current of air by the movement of its blades. It is also used to refer to a person who has a strong interest in and admiration for a particular person or thing.

words.ex: The new software helps employees multitask efficiently.
words.ex_cn: 新软件帮助员工同时处理多项任务。
words.en: To perform more than one task at the same time.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 上床睡觉；上交；告发；交还
words.ex: It's late, so I'll turn in now.
words.ex_cn: 很晚了，我现在上床睡觉。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or something that is lost.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；弄明白；解决；想出
words.ex: I can't figure out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我算不出答案。
words.en: To understand or solve something by thinking about it.

words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 当然，我会帮你做作业。
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: phrase. 参加…选拔；测试；试验
words.ex: He wants to try out for the school soccer team.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加校足球队的选拔。
words.en: To test something to see if it is suitable or effective.

words.ex: We need to settle on a date for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要选定一个旅行的日期。
words.en: To decide on something after considering it carefully.

words.ex: I keep track of my expenses every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天记录我的开支。
words.en: To keep track of something means to stay informed about it or to record it, especially in order to notice any changes or developments.

words.tr: phrase. 忙碌不停；四处奔波；在路上；在进行中
words.ex: He eats snacks on the go.
words.ex_cn: 他一边赶路一边吃零食。
words.en: If you are on the go, you are very busy and active, moving from one place or task to another.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 休息一下；暂停工作或活动
words.ex: He takes a break after working for two hours.
words.ex_cn: 他工作两小时后休息一下。
words.en: To stop doing something for a short period of time in order to rest or do something else.

words.ex: The lights went out all at once.
words.ex_cn: 灯一下子全灭了。
words.en: Suddenly; at the same time.

words.ex: He can eat one apple at a time.
words.ex_cn: 他一次只能吃一个苹果。
words.en: Indicates the number of items or actions that are involved in a single instance or occurrence.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.ex: The waitperson brought us water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 服务员很快给我们端来了水。
words.en: A waitperson is someone whose job is to serve customers at their tables in a restaurant.

words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.tr: phrase. 第一；最重要的人或事物
words.ex: He is number one in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上第一名。
words.en: The term 'number one' refers to the first in a series or the best in a particular category. It can also denote the most important person or thing in a specific context.

words.ex: He made a quick decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速做出了离开的决定。
words.en: A decision is a choice that you make about something after thinking about it.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: He will tackle the problem tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会处理这个问题。
words.en: If you tackle a problem or task, you deal with it in a determined way. In sports such as football and rugby, a tackle is an act of trying to take the ball from a player on the other team.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.tr:
n. 等级；
v. 分等级；
words.ex: He earned a high rank in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中获得了很高的等级。
words.en: If you rank things or people, you arrange them in order of importance or quality. If someone or something ranks in a particular position, they are in that position on a scale that measures something such as importance or quality.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.ex: People gather in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人们在广场上聚集庆祝节日。
words.en: If people gather somewhere, or if someone gathers people somewhere, they come together in a group.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.tr: v. 将…分类；把…加以归类
words.ex: We categorize books by genre.
words.ex_cn: 我们按类型对书籍进行分类。
words.en: To categorize means to put people or things into groups according to their type or characteristics.

words.ex: She wears everyday clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 她穿日常的衣服去上班。
words.en: Something that is everyday is ordinary and common, not special or unusual.

words.tr: adj. 即刻的；立即的；紧接的；最近的；
words.ex: He needs immediate help.
words.ex_cn: 他需要即刻的帮助。
words.en: An immediate action, event, or situation happens or exists without any delay.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: He squeezed into the small seat.
words.ex_cn: 他挤进了小座位里。
words.en: To squeeze something means to press it firmly, usually with your fingers or hands, often to get liquid out of it or to make it smaller.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.tr:
adj. 期中的
n. 期中考试
words.ex: He is preparing for his midterm exam next week.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为下周的期中考试做准备。
words.en: A midterm is an examination that is given in the middle of a term in a school or college.

words.ex: He saves money for long-term goals.
words.ex_cn: 他为长期目标存钱。
words.en: Something that is long-term has continued for a long time or will continue for a long time in the future.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室做实验。
words.en: A lab is a place where scientific experiments and research are conducted.

words.tr: adj. 兼职的；部分时间的
words.ex: He works part-time at a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家咖啡店做兼职。
words.en: If someone is a part-time worker or has a part-time job, they work for only part of each day or week.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.tr: v. 重新评价；再估价；使升值
words.ex: He will reevaluate his decision tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会重新评估他的决定。
words.en: If you reevaluate something or someone, you consider them again in order to reassess your opinion about them, especially if you think that your opinion should be changed.

words.ex: We will revisit the beach next summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们明年夏天会重游那片海滩。
words.en: If you revisit a place, you return there for a second or subsequent time, often after a considerable period.

words.ex: He briefly explained the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他简要地解释了这个计划。
words.en: For a short time; in few words.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.tr:
n. 意义；感知；理解力；知觉；
v. 感觉到；觉察出；意识到；
words.ex: The story has no sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事没有意义。
words.en: A sense is a feeling or awareness about something, or a physical ability such as sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 各就各位，预备，跑！（比赛开始口令）
words.ex: She says ready, set, go, and runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 她说准备，开始，跑，然后快速奔跑。
words.en: A phrase used to signal the start of a race or any competitive activity.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 不可改变的；固定不变的
words.ex: The rules are not set in stone and can change.
words.ex_cn: 这些规则不是固定的，可以改变。
words.en: If something is set in stone, it cannot be changed or altered because it has been decided upon definitively.

words.tr: phrase. 退居次要地位；让位于（某人或某事）
words.ex: He always takes a back seat to his boss in meetings.
words.ex_cn: 在会议上他总是让老板出头。
words.en: To become less important than someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 拔出；驶离路边；退出
words.ex: He pulled out a coin from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一枚硬币。
words.en: To remove something or someone from a place or situation.

words.ex: He left right away when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他一听到消息就离开了。
words.en: If you do something right away, you do it immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 完成；解决；逐渐穿过；穿透
words.ex: He worked through all the math problems before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了所有的数学题。
words.en: To deal with or solve a problem or task completely or thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. v. 勾选；核对并标记完成
words.ex: He checks off each task when he finishes it.
words.ex_cn: 他每完成一项任务就打个勾。
words.en: To mark something on a list as completed or verified.

words.tr: v. 以…为基础；“base”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 基地 (或总部) 在…的；办公地点在…的（不用于名词前）；
words.ex: The movie is based on a true story.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影以一个真实故事为基础。
words.en: If one thing is based on another, the first thing is developed from or uses the second thing as its main idea or starting point.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.ex: His room is messy with clothes everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很杂乱，衣服到处都是。
words.en: If you describe something as messy, you mean that it is untidy or dirty.

words.ex: He is constantly checking his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不断地查看他的手机。
words.en: If something happens constantly, it happens all the time or very often.

words.ex: The smell was unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这气味令人不快。
words.en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example, by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

words.ex: The children felt delight when they saw the toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到玩具时感到高兴。
words.en: Delight is a feeling of very great pleasure.

words.ex: He gave a bold speech in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前发表了大胆的演讲。
words.en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.tr: adj. 优秀的；杰出的；卓越的；
words.ex: He got an excellent score on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.

words.tr:
v. 努力；斗争；挣扎；
n. 努力；斗争；难事；
words.ex: He struggles to finish his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都努力完成作业。
words.en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though it is difficult or other people are making it difficult for you.

words.ex: His death made everyone very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的去世让所有人都很难过。
words.en: The end of the life of a person or organism.

words.tr:
adj. 偏僻的；离群的；孤独的；内向的
v. 撤回；撤退；“withdraw”的过去分词
words.ex: The cabin is in a withdrawn area, far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 小木屋位于一个偏僻的地方，远离城镇。
words.en: If someone is withdrawn, they are very quiet, and do not want to talk to other people. If something is withdrawn, it is taken back or removed.

words.ex: He felt ashamed for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对妈妈撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: If someone is ashamed, they feel embarrassed or guilty because of something they have done or because of their appearance.

words.ex: We buy gifts for Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 我们为圣诞节买礼物。
words.en: Christmas is the period around the 25th of December when Christians celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.ex: She tied a red ribbon around the box.
words.ex_cn: 她把一条红色的带状物系在盒子上。
words.en: A ribbon is a long, narrow piece of cloth that you use for tying things together or as a decoration.

words.ex: He clumsily dropped the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他笨拙地打翻了玻璃杯。
words.en: In a way that is awkward in movement or handling things.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread at the grocery.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocery is a store where food and small items for the house are sold.

words.ex: She wore a dress with rhinestone stars.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条镶有水钻星星的裙子。
words.en: A rhinestone is a diamond simulant made from rock crystal, glass, or acrylic. Originally, rhinestones were rock crystals gathered from the river Rhine, hence the name, but today the term is used for any simulant of a diamond.

words.ex: She wears a silver bracelet every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天戴一条银手链。
words.en: A bracelet is a piece of jewellery that you wear around your wrist or arm.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.ex: The smoke began to stifle her breathing.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾开始让她窒息。
words.en: To stifle something means to prevent it from happening, continuing, or developing.

words.ex: The children's laughter filled the room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的笑声充满了房间。
words.en: The sound of people laughing, especially when it is loud and continuous.

words.ex: He exclaim when he saw the surprise.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到惊喜时，他大喊起来。
words.en: If you exclaim, you say something suddenly and loudly, often because you are surprised, excited, or angry.

words.tr:
v. 轻拍；轻触；轻敷
n. 轻拍；少量；能手；比目鱼
words.ex: He dabbed paint on the wall with a brush.
words.ex_cn: 他用刷子在墙上点了一些颜料。
words.en: To dab means to touch something lightly and quickly, often with a cloth or your fingers, in order to clean it, dry it, or apply something to it.

words.ex: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他打篮球时伤了手腕。
words.en: The part of your body where your hand joins your arm.

words.ex: My mom makes breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A mother; a female parent.

words.ex: The fish is still alive in the water.
words.ex_cn: 这条鱼还在水里活着。
words.en: If people or animals are alive, they are not dead.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；尊敬；
v. 尊敬；给予荣誉；履行；
words.ex: He received an honor for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因勇敢的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honor is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. A person who has honor is someone who is admired and respected because of his or her integrity and ethical behavior.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；
v. 尊敬；
words.ex: He received an honour for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因英勇的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honour is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. It is a measure of a person's reputation and the esteem in which they are held by others.

words.ex: I assure you that everything will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 我向你保证一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you assure someone that something is true or will happen, you tell them that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, often in order to make them less worried.

words.ex: He earned a bachelor in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了计算机科学学士学位。
words.en: A bachelor is a man who has never been married.

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: The wedding was held in a small church.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。
words.en: A wedding is a marriage ceremony and the party or special meal that often takes place after the ceremony.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: The mother grooms her puppy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈每天早上给她的小狗梳理毛发。
words.en: A groom is a man who is getting married. Also, to groom means to clean and brush an animal, or to prepare someone for a particular job or position.

words.tr: abbr. 出票；提存；提款；“drawing”的缩写
words.ex: The dr. was signed on the ticket.
words.ex_cn: 票上签了出票人。
words.en: Dr. is a title used before the name of a doctor or someone who has a PhD.

words.tr:
v. 耳语；低语
n. 耳语；低语；沙沙的声音
words.ex: He whispered a secret to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友低语了一个秘密。
words.en: To speak very quietly using one's breath rather than one's throat, especially for the sake of privacy.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子前面。
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: phrase. 以……为乐；喜欢；对……感到愉快
words.ex: He takes delight in watching birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都乐于观鸟。
words.en: To enjoy something very much.

words.tr: phrase. 采取措施；采取步骤
words.ex: We must take steps to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须采取措施保护环境。
words.en: To take steps means to begin a course of action intended to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: He has finished his homework by now.
words.ex_cn: 到目前为止，他已经完成了作业。
words.en: Up to the present moment; at this time.

words.tr: phrase. 为自己感到羞愧；因自己的行为或想法而感到内疚或惭愧
words.ex: He is ashamed of himself for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: To feel deep personal regret or guilt for one's own actions or behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 下苦功；费心尽力；认真努力做某事
words.ex: He takes pains to help his classmates with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他费尽心思帮助同学做作业。
words.en: If you take pains to do something or go to great pains to do something, you try hard to do it, because you think it is important to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 不辞辛劳地做某事；费心尽力做某事
words.ex: He takes pains to write every letter clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他努力把每个字母写得清晰。
words.en: To make a great effort to ensure that something is done well or correctly.

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: To focus one's mind or efforts on something or someone, especially in order to understand or learn.

words.tr: phrase. 变得活跃起来；变得生动有趣；苏醒过来
words.ex: The city comes alive at night.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市在夜晚变得热闹起来。
words.en: To become lively or animated; to become active or full of life.

words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.ex: He is late at times.
words.ex_cn: 他有时会迟到。
words.en: on some occasions; occasionally

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.ex: I believe in working hard to achieve my dreams.
words.ex_cn: 我相信努力工作能实现我的梦想。
words.en: To feel certain that something exists or is true, or to have confidence in a person or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.ex: He works on a large ranch in Texas.
words.ex_cn: 他在德克萨斯州的一个大牧场工作。
words.en: A ranch is a large farm, especially in the western United States and Canada, where cattle or other animals are bred and raised.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.tr:
adj. 巡回的；流动的
n. 四处奔波的人；流浪者
words.ex: The itinerant worker moves from town to town for jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这位流动工人为了工作从一个城镇搬到另一个城镇。
words.en: Someone who is itinerant travels from place to place, usually because they have no permanent home or job, or because they are involved in a particular activity that requires this.

words.ex: The trainer helped the athlete improve his speed.
words.ex_cn: 训练者帮助运动员提高了他的速度。
words.en: A trainer is someone who teaches skills to people or animals and prepares them for a job, activity, or sport.

words.ex: The bridge is stable and safe to cross.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥很稳固，可以安全通过。
words.en: If something is stable, it is not likely to change or come to an end suddenly.

words.ex: He continually checks his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地查看手机。
words.en: If something happens continually, it happens without stopping or happening repeatedly over a period of time.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个图表来解释水循环。
words.en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

words.ex: He owns five acres of farmland.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有五英亩的农田。
words.en: A unit of area used in the US Customary and the British Imperial systems, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,046.86 square meters.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.tr: adj. 不切实际的；不实事求是的；
words.ex: It's unrealistic to expect to get rich quickly.
words.ex_cn: 指望快速致富是不切实际的。
words.en: If you say that someone is being unrealistic, you mean that they do not recognize the truth about a situation, especially about the difficulties involved in something they want to achieve.

words.ex: He had to rewrite his essay after the teacher gave feedback.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师给出反馈后不得不重写他的作文。
words.en: If someone rewrites a piece of writing such as a book, an article, or a law, they write it in a different way in order to improve it or because circumstances have changed.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.tr: v. 重新考虑；重新审议
words.ex: He must reconsider his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他必须重新考虑他的决定。
words.en: If you reconsider a decision or opinion, you think about it and try to decide whether it should be changed.

words.ex: He will assemble the toy for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他将为儿子组装玩具。
words.en: If people assemble or if someone assembles them, they come together in a group, usually for a particular purpose such as a meeting.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.ex: He sits by the fireplace in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天他坐在壁炉旁。
words.en: A fireplace is a place built into a wall where you can have a fire, especially in a house.

words.ex: The stealer took his phone from the table.
words.ex_cn: 小偷从桌子上拿走了他的手机。
words.en: A stealer is someone who steals something.

words.ex: He stole a book from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店偷了一本书。
words.en: To take something that belongs to someone else without their permission and without intending to return it.

words.ex: Fortunately, the bus came just in time.
words.ex_cn: 幸运的是，公交车正好准时到了。
words.en: Used to say that something good has happened, especially when it could have been bad.

words.tr: n. 精明强干；机智；老练；胆量
words.ex: He had enough gumption to start his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他有足够的胆识去创办自己的公司。
words.en: If someone has gumption, they are able to think what it would be sensible to do in a particular situation, and they do it.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会回他的家乡。
words.en: To return to a previous place, time, or subject.

words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.ex: He explained the plan in detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地解释了这个计划。
words.en: Including all the facts or aspects of a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 全心投入；倾注全部心血于
words.ex: He puts his heart into every song he sings.
words.ex_cn: 他把全部心血都投入到他唱的每一首歌中。
words.en: To devote oneself wholeheartedly to a task or activity.

words.ex: He spends a great deal of time on homework.
words.ex_cn: 他花大量时间做作业。
words.en: A large amount or quantity of something.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.tr: phrase. v. 把某物交给某人（通常指上交作业、文件等）
words.ex: He handed in his homework to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业交给了老师。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.tr: phrase. 绝不；没门；不可能；表示强烈否定或惊讶
words.ex: No way will I eat that food.
words.ex_cn: 我绝不会吃那种食物。
words.en: used to say that there is no possibility that you will do something or that something will happen

words.tr: 短语. 不可能；没有办法；绝无可能
words.ex: There is no way he can finish the race in ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他不可能在十分钟内跑完这场比赛。
words.en: Used to express that something is completely impossible or cannot happen under any circumstances.

words.ex: He made up his mind to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他下定决心戒烟。
words.en: To decide something after considering it carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 自己拿定主意；自己做决定
words.ex: You should make up your own mind about what to do.
words.ex_cn: 你应该自己决定该做什么。
words.en: To decide something after thinking about it, especially when it is a difficult decision.

words.tr: phrase. 上床睡觉；上交；告发；交还
words.ex: It's late, so I'll turn in now.
words.ex_cn: 很晚了，我现在上床睡觉。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or something that is lost.

words.ex: He will return to school next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将返回学校。
words.en: To go back to a previous state, place, or topic.

words.ex: We will camp out near the lake this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我们将在湖边露营。
words.en: To camp out means to stay overnight in a tent or temporary shelter, often in a natural setting such as a forest or beside a lake.

words.tr: 短语，表示‘某种程度上是…；有点儿…’（常用于委婉或轻描淡写地描述某人或某事物）
words.ex: He is something of a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面有点天才。
words.en: Used to indicate that someone or something has a particular quality to some extent.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 对…放弃希望或努力；不再继续支持或尝试
words.ex: After failing the test several times, he decided to give up on his dream of becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: v. 在多次考试失败后，他决定放弃成为医生的梦想。
words.en: If you give up on something or someone, you stop trying to do or achieve something, or stop believing that they can succeed or improve.

words.ex: I will help you, no matter what.
words.ex_cn: 无论怎样，我都会帮你。
words.en: Regardless of what happens or what the circumstances are.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr: n. 客户服务；顾客关怀
words.ex: The customer-care team helps people with their problems.
words.ex_cn: 客户服务团队帮助人们解决他们的问题。
words.en: Customer-care refers to the service and support provided to customers before, during, and after purchasing and using products or services. It is aimed at ensuring customer satisfaction and loyalty.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 责任；责备；
v. 责怪；归咎于；
words.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.ex: He wore a crazy hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶疯狂的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as crazy, you mean that they are very enthusiastic or excited about something.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.ex: He eats ice cream after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃冰淇淋。
words.en: A sweet, creamy frozen food made from milk fat, sugar, and flavorings.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He will vote for the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 他将投票支持新领袖。
words.en: If you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

words.ex: Call me whenever you need help.
words.ex_cn: 无论何时你需要帮助，就给我打电话。
words.en: at any or every time that

words.ex: He forgot his homework, and understandably, the teacher was upset.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了作业，老师生气是可以理解的。
words.en: In a way that is easy to understand or that seems reasonable or expected.

words.ex: He is skeptical about the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新计划持怀疑态度。
words.en: If you are skeptical about something, you have doubts about it.

words.tr:
n. 后者（the ~）；
adj. 后期的；后面的；
words.ex: I like tea and coffee; I prefer the latter.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶和咖啡；我更喜欢后者。
words.en: The latter is used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.ex: He obviously forgot his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他显然忘了做作业。
words.en: in a way that is easily perceived or understood; clearly.

words.ex: He is a well-educated man who works at a university.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位受过良好教育的男子，在大学工作。
words.en: Someone who is well-educated has received a good education and has a lot of knowledge.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: He eats a strawberry every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗草莓。
words.en: A strawberry is a small red fruit which is soft and juicy and has tiny yellow seeds on its surface.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: He quickly jot down the phone number.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙记下了电话号码。
words.en: To write or mark down quickly or briefly.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: He walked forth to meet the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去迎接太阳。
words.en: Forward in time, place, or order; onward.

words.tr: abbr. 诸如此类；等等；“et cetera”的缩写
words.ex: I bought apples, bananas, etc.
words.ex_cn: 我买了苹果、香蕉等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that further, similar items are included.

words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.tr: n. 情况；事例；案件；外壳；容器（箱，盒）；
words.ex: In this case, we should wait longer.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们应该再等一会儿。
words.en: A particular situation or example of something.

words.ex: The pickup is at 7 PM outside the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 接人时间是晚上7点，在酒店外面。
words.en: A pickup is an improvement or recovery, especially in business or health. It can also refer to the act of collecting someone or something, or a small truck with an open back.

words.tr:
n. 柜台；
v. 抵消；反驳；
adv. 相反地；
words.ex: The customer paid at the counter.
words.ex_cn: 顾客在柜台付款。
words.en: A counter is a long flat surface in a shop or bank on which customers are served. It can also refer to a device that counts something, or an action taken to oppose something.

words.tr: adv. 大幅度地；相当地；很大地；
words.ex: The price has increased considerably.
words.ex_cn: 价格大幅上涨了。
words.en: To a notably large or significant extent.

words.ex: The water vapor rose into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 水蒸气升上了天空。
words.en: Vapor is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapor can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.ex: The water is sufficiently warm to swim.
words.ex_cn: 水温足够暖和，可以游泳。
words.en: To an adequate degree; enough.

words.tr: v. 驱散；消散；浪费；挥霍
words.ex: The fog will dissipate by noon.
words.ex_cn: 雾将在中午前消散。
words.en: If something dissipates or is dissipated, it becomes less or becomes less strong until it disappears or goes away completely.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He gave a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地道歉了。
words.en: If you say that someone is sincere, you approve of them because they really mean the things they say.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 对…进行投票表决；就…投票
words.ex: They will vote on the new rule tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将对新规则进行投票。
words.en: To express one's choice or opinion, especially in an official election or decision-making process.

words.ex: He said he would come, and sure enough, he arrived at 7 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他说他会来，果然，他在晚上7点到了。
words.en: As expected or predicted; indeed.

words.ex: He takes notes during the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时做笔记。
words.en: To write down information, especially during a lecture or meeting, in order to remember it later.

words.ex: He likes to jot down ideas in his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢把想法记在笔记本上。
words.en: To write or mark down quickly or briefly.

words.ex: He moves back and forth between two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他在两把椅子之间来回移动。
words.en: Moving in one direction and then in the opposite direction repeatedly.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 冷却下来；平静下来；使冷静
words.ex: The car needs time to cool down after driving.
words.ex_cn: 汽车行驶后需要时间冷却下来。
words.en: To become less hot, or to make something become less hot; to become calm after being angry.

words.tr: n. 一个特殊日子的前夕或前夜
words.ex: The eve of Christmas is very special.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞节前夜非常特别。
words.en: The period of time immediately before an event or occasion, especially the day before a holiday or festival.

words.ex: This book is a best-seller in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在许多国家都是畅销书。
words.en: A best-seller is a book or other product that sells in very large numbers.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.ex: The baby ate the tender broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝吃了嫩的西兰花。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as tender, you mean that they are kind, gentle, and sympathetic. If meat or other food is tender, it is easy to cut or chew. To tender something such as a service or a resignation means to formally offer or present it.

words.ex: He deserves a break after working so hard.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作后值得休息一下。
words.en: If you say that a person or thing deserves something, you mean that they should have it or receive it because of their actions or qualities.

words.ex: The ministry of education controls schools.
words.ex_cn: 教育部管理学校。
words.en: A ministry is a government department, especially in Britain, which is responsible for a particular area of administration, such as health or education.

words.ex: He will renew his passport next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会更新他的护照。
words.en: To renew something means to begin it again or to make it new again.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.ex: The priest gave a long sermon about kindness.
words.ex_cn: 牧师做了一场关于仁爱的长时间布道。
words.en: A sermon is a talk on a religious or moral subject, especially one given during a church service.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.tr: adj. 多虱的；可鄙的；差劲的
words.ex: The dog had a lousy coat full of fleas.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的毛发多虱子。
words.en: If you describe something as lousy, you mean that it is of very bad quality or that you do not like it.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: He contends that education is the key to success.
words.ex_cn: 他主张教育是成功的关键。
words.en: If you contend with someone or contend with something, you have to deal with a difficult situation or problem. If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

words.ex: He is a deep thinker who solves problems slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个深思熟虑的思考者，慢慢解决问题。
words.en: A thinker is someone who spends a lot of time thinking deeply about important things, especially someone who is famous for thinking of new or interesting ideas.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.ex: He frequently visits his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If something happens frequently, it happens often.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: It is evident that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is evident, it is easy to see, perceive, or understand.

words.tr: adj. 被践踏的，被蹂躏的；受压迫的
words.ex: The downtrodden workers asked for better pay.
words.ex_cn: 被压迫的工人们要求提高工资。
words.en: Someone who is downtrodden is treated badly and without respect by people who have power over them.

words.tr: adv. 自然地；理所当然地；
words.ex: Babies cry naturally when they are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿饿了时会自然地哭。
words.en: in a natural manner; as a matter of course; by nature

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.ex: The police opened an inquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An inquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

words.tr: v. 压下；降低；使沮丧；使不活泼；使萧条
words.ex: He depresses the button to start the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他按下按钮启动机器。
words.en: If something depresses you, it makes you feel sad and disappointed.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.ex: He made a proposition to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了降低税收的建议。
words.en: A proposition is a statement or an idea that people can consider or discuss to decide whether it is true.

words.ex: They reside in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: If someone resides somewhere, they live there or are staying there.

words.ex: The teacher will determine the winner of the contest.
words.ex_cn: 老师将确定比赛的获胜者。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.ex: The old cemetery is near the church.
words.ex_cn: 那个古老的墓地在教堂附近。
words.en: A cemetery is a place where dead people are buried.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.tr: v. 警告；告诫；提醒注意；
words.ex: The teacher warned the students not to be late.
words.ex_cn: 老师警告学生不要迟到。
words.en: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.ex: He put his job in jeopardy by being late every day.
words.ex_cn: 他因为每天迟到而危及了自己的工作。
words.en: Jeopardy is a situation of exposure to danger or harm.

words.tr: v. 砰地关上；猛地一动；抨击
words.ex: He slammed the door angrily.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把门砰地关上。
words.en: If you slam a door or window, or if it slams, it shuts noisily and with great force.

words.ex: He prays every morning before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃早餐前祈祷。
words.en: To pray means to speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for something.

words.tr: n. 勋爵；主；上帝；统治者；
words.ex: The lord lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位勋爵住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A lord is a man who has a high rank in the nobility, especially in Britain, or a man who has authority or control over others.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He has nothing but praise for his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师只有赞美。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is only what you say it is and nothing more

words.ex: I wake up at seven every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点醒来。
words.en: To stop sleeping and become conscious, or to make someone stop sleeping.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.tr: phrase. 尽快地；尽可能迅速地
words.ex: Please finish your homework as quickly as possible.
words.ex_cn: 请尽快完成你的作业。
words.en: As quickly as possible means doing something with the highest speed or in the shortest time achievable.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: phrase. 对...感到厌烦；受够了...
words.ex: He is fed up with doing the same work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他厌倦了每天做同样的工作。
words.en: To be bored, annoyed, or unhappy, especially with a situation that has existed for a long time.

words.ex: He wants to get rid of the old chair.
words.ex_cn: 他想扔掉那把旧椅子。
words.en: To dispose of or remove something unwanted or undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 对…充耳不闻；故意不理睬
words.ex: He always turns a deaf ear to my advice.
words.ex_cn: 他总是对我的建议充耳不闻。
words.en: To ignore or refuse to listen to someone or something.

words.w: as far as i could determine
words.tr: phrase. 就我所能确定的；据我所知
words.uk: æz fɑːr æz aɪ kʊd dɪˈtɜːmɪn
words.us: æz fɑːr æz aɪ kʊd dɪˈtɜːrmɪn
words.ex: As far as I could determine, the bus leaves at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 据我所能确定的，公交车晚上6点发车。
words.en: To the best of one's knowledge or after careful investigation; as far as one could ascertain.

words.ex: See the problem in perspective.
words.ex_cn: 从正确的角度来看待这个问题。
words.en: If you see something in perspective, you see it in a way that shows its true importance or value.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 处于危险中；受到威胁
words.ex: The boat is in jeopardy because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 由于风暴，这艘船处于危险之中。
words.en: If something is in jeopardy, it is in danger of being damaged or destroyed.

words.tr: phrase. 正在离开；即将过时；快要被淘汰
words.ex: The old phone is on the way out.
words.ex_cn: 这部旧手机正在被淘汰。
words.en: Becoming less popular or common; about to leave or disappear.

words.tr: 短语动词. 跪下；屈膝；恳求
words.ex: He got on his knees to tie his shoe.
words.ex_cn: 他跪下系鞋带。
words.en: To kneel down, typically as a gesture of respect, submission, or supplication.

words.tr:
adj. 稳定的；
v. 使稳住；
words.ex: The boat moved in a steady way on the calm sea.
words.ex_cn: 船在平静的海面上平稳地移动。
words.en: If something is steady, it is firm and does not shake or move about. If you steady something, you stop it from shaking or moving about.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.tr: adv. 非常地；极其地；极端地；
words.ex: The weather is extremely cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气非常冷。
words.en: To an extreme degree; very.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.ex: He seeks help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: If you seek something, you try to find it or obtain it.

words.tr:
adj. 青少年的；幼稚的；
n. 少年；
words.ex: The book is written for juvenile readers.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为青少年读者撰写的。
words.en: A juvenile is a child or young person who is not yet old enough to be considered an adult.

words.ex: The loud noise scared the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something scares you, it frightens or worries you.

words.ex: The doctor checked his glucose level.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的血糖水平。
words.en: A simple sugar which is an important energy source in living organisms and is a component of many carbohydrates.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.ex: The pancreas makes insulin to control blood sugar.
words.ex_cn: 胰腺分泌胰岛素来控制血糖。
words.en: The pancreas is a large gland behind the stomach which secretes digestive enzymes into the duodenum. Embedded in the pancreas are the islets of Langerhans, which secrete into the blood the hormones insulin and glucagon.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.ex: He takes insulin to control his blood sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他注射胰岛素来控制血糖。
words.en: A hormone produced in the pancreas by the islets of Langerhans, which regulates the amount of glucose in the blood. The lack of insulin causes a form of diabetes.

words.ex: You must clean the room properly.
words.ex_cn: 你必须正确地打扫房间。
words.en: If something is done properly, it is done in a correct and satisfactory way.

words.tr:
n. 带位员；接待员；门房
v. 引领；招待；做招待员
words.ex: The usher showed us to our seats in the theater.
words.ex_cn: 带位员带我们到了剧院的座位。
words.en: An usher is someone who shows people where to sit, especially at a formal event such as a wedding or a concert. As a verb, to usher means to show someone where to go or to lead them somewhere.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.ex: The company made drastic cuts to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司进行了急剧的削减以节省资金。
words.en: If you describe a change or action as drastic, you mean that it is extreme and often severe.

words.ex: This is a basic math skill.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个基本的数学技能。
words.en: You use basic to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or necessary, and on which others depend.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.ex: He felt uneasy when he heard the strange noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到奇怪的声音时，他感到不安。
words.en: If you are uneasy, you feel anxious, afraid, or embarrassed, because you think that something is wrong or that there is danger.

words.tr: adj. 未经治疗的；未处理的
words.ex: The water is untreated and unsafe to drink.
words.ex_cn: 这水未经处理，不能喝。
words.en: If something is untreated, it has not been dealt with in any way.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: He drank water to help his kidney work better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝水以帮助肾脏更好地工作。
words.en: One of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.tr: adj. 能治疗的；能处理的
words.ex: This disease is treatable with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 这种病可以通过药物治疗。
words.en: If a disease or condition is treatable, it can be cured or made better with medical care.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.ex: The nurse will inject medicine into his arm.
words.ex_cn: 护士将把药水注入他的手臂。
words.en: To inject a substance such as a medicine or drug means to put it into someone's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.ex: He checks his blood-sugar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上检查血糖。
words.en: Blood-sugar refers to the concentration of glucose in the blood, which is a critical measure for diagnosing and managing diabetes.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.tr: adj. 富含碳水化合物的
words.ex: The boy ate a carbohydrate-rich meal before the race.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在比赛前吃了一顿富含碳水化合物的饭。
words.en: Containing a high proportion of carbohydrates, which are a major source of energy for the body.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.ex: The doctor can diagnose the illness quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生能很快诊断出这种病。
words.en: If someone or something is diagnosed as having a particular illness or problem, their illness or problem is identified. If an illness or problem is diagnosed, it is identified.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 改善；整顿；振作起来（常用于督促某人改进行为或表现）
words.ex: You need to shape up if you want to pass the class.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想通过这门课，你就得表现好一点。
words.en: To improve or develop in a particular way.

words.ex: It is quite cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天很冷。
words.en: To a certain or fairly significant extent or degree; fairly.

words.tr: 表示即将做某事，用于描述马上要发生的动作，后接动词原形
words.ex: He is about to leave the house.
words.ex_cn: 他正要离开家。
words.en: If you are about to do something, you are going to do it very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 感觉不舒服；感觉不在状态；感到身体或情绪不适
words.ex: I don't feel myself today; I think I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我今天感觉不太对劲，我想我需要休息一下。
words.en: To feel unwell or not as one usually feels, often due to illness or stress.

words.ex: At first, he did not like math.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他不喜欢数学。
words.en: At the beginning; initially.

words.tr: phrase. 该受责备；应承担责任
words.ex: He is to blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误该怪他。
words.en: If someone is to blame for something bad that has happened, they are responsible for causing it.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 使某事物处于控制之下；把某事控制住；抑制住某事
words.ex: He keeps his anger under control.
words.ex_cn: 他控制住自己的愤怒。
words.en: To maintain something in a state where it is manageable or not causing problems.

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr: 短语动词. 取得很大进展；有了长足的进步；经历了很长的路程（尤指在发展或改善方面）
words.ex: He has come a long way since he started learning English.
words.ex_cn: 自从他开始学英语以来，他已经取得了很大进步。
words.en: To have made significant progress or improvement over a period of time.

words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.ex: He is physically tired after running five kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完五公里后身体上很累。
words.en: In a way that relates to the body as opposed to the mind; in a way that relates to things that can be seen or touched.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打排球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.tr: v. （使）参与；从事于；雇佣；“engage”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 忙着的；
words.ex: The teacher engaged the students in a group discussion.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们参与了一次小组讨论。
words.en: If you are engaged in an activity, you are doing it or involved in it. If you are engaged to someone, you have agreed to marry them.

words.ex: The play ended in a tragedy when the hero died.
words.ex_cn: 当英雄去世时，这部戏剧以悲剧收场。
words.en: A tragedy is an extremely sad event or situation.

words.ex: He is going to marry his fiancée next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月要和未婚妻结婚。
words.en: A woman who is engaged to be married.

words.ex: The passenger got off the bus at the next stop.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅客在下一站下了车。
words.en: A passenger is a person who is traveling in a vehicle but is not the driver or one of the people who works on it.

words.tr: phrase. 副驾驶座；乘客座位
words.ex: He sat in the passenger seat during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行时坐在副驾驶座上。
words.en: The front seat next to the driver in a vehicle, typically considered the seat for a passenger.

words.ex: He will fasten his seatbelt before driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车前会系好安全带。
words.en: To close or attach something firmly so that it will not open or come loose.

words.ex: The factory uses a belt to move boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用传送带来运送箱子。
words.en: A belt is a strip of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration.

words.ex: The baby is asleep in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在婴儿床里睡着了。
words.en: If someone is asleep, they are sleeping.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.ex: They used cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水泥建造了这堵墙。
words.en: Cement is a powdery substance which is mixed with water and used for sticking things together or for making very hard surfaces.

words.tr: n. 桥礅，桥台；支撑（点）；邻接，毗连
words.ex: The bridge rests on a strong abutment.
words.ex_cn: 桥梁依靠一个坚固的桥台支撑。
words.en: An abutment is a structure that supports and resists the lateral pressure of an arch or span, especially at the ends of a bridge.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: The ambulance arrived quickly to help the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 救护车迅速到达以帮助受伤的男人。
words.en: An ambulance is a vehicle equipped to transport the sick or injured, especially to a hospital.

words.ex: The teacher will announce the results tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天将宣布结果。
words.en: To announce something means to make it known publicly or officially.

words.tr: n. 四肢瘫痪者; adj. 四肢瘫痪的
words.ex: He is a quadriplegic after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后成为四肢瘫痪者。
words.en: A quadriplegic is a person who is permanently unable to move or feel both arms and both legs, usually because of injury or illness.

words.tr: n. [解剖]三头肌（tricep 的复数形式）
words.ex: He is strengthening his triceps with push-ups.
words.ex_cn: 他通过俯卧撑锻炼三头肌。
words.en: The triceps is a large muscle on the back of the upper limb of many vertebrates. It is the muscle principally responsible for extension of the elbow joint (straightening of the arm).

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.tr: adj. 运动的；身强力壮的；
words.ex: He is an athletic boy who loves running.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱跑步的运动型男孩。
words.en: Athletic is used to describe someone who is physically strong, fit, and good at sports, or something related to sports or physical activities.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: He worked here previously.
words.ex_cn: 他以前在这里工作。
words.en: At an earlier time or before.

words.ex: The children screamed with joy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们因喜悦而尖叫。
words.en: Joy is a feeling of great happiness.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.tr:
n. 床边；床头；床侧
adj. 床旁的；枕边的
words.ex: He left his glasses on the bedside.
words.ex_cn: 他把眼镜放在了床边。
words.en: The area beside a bed, especially in a hospital or someone's home.

words.ex: The sky will darken before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，天空会变暗。
words.en: To make or become dark or darker.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.ex: The child's recovery was a miracle.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的康复是个奇迹。
words.en: A miracle is an event that cannot be explained by the laws of nature and is therefore considered to be the work of a divine agency.

words.ex: He lost his fortune in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了他的财产。
words.en: A large amount of money or assets; chance or luck as an external force in human affairs.

words.ex: He joined a local book association.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了一个本地的图书协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
